## Core Mechanized Invariants & Microarchitectural Bounds
- **I1 (Non-Authorization State Conservation):** $D(a) = \text{DENY} \implies \Delta_{\text{external}}(a) = 0$
  - **Actuator Command Gate:** $\text{Gate}(a) = \text{DENY} \implies \text{Command}_{\text{actuator}} = \mathbf{0}$ (Zero unauthorized command emission; active holding torque / ballast seals autonomous)
- **I2 (Single-Commit Effect Gate):** $\sum_{e \in E(o)} \mathbf{1}[\text{Committed}(e, t)] \le 1$
- **I3 (Zero Ambient Authority):** Atomic capability-bound tokens; proposal generation strictly decoupled from execution authority (Proposer != Executor).
- **Physical Memory Bounds ($S_{\max}$):** $\le 4096\text{ B}$ static frame budget; TCM physical bounds $[1024..=2048]$.
- **Dynamic Allocation ($M_{\text{alloc}}$):** $0\text{ B}$ on critical ingress paths (`#![no_std]`, `#[forbid(unsafe_code)]`).
- **Hardware Fallback Latency ($\tau_{\text{override}}$):** $\le 11.99\text{ ms}$ via ARMv8-M Cortex-M33 NMI actuator pull-down (5ms hardware watchdog).
- **Sovereign Constancy ($C_{\text{ops}}$):** $= 0$ operational drag.

## Normative Poset Dominance & Categorical Bridge (ARC-ERR-2026-001)
- **Normative Operational Poset (E):**  
  $\text{BREACH (POSIX 40)} \succ \text{REFUSAL (POSIX 32)} \succ \text{CORRUPT (POSIX 30)} \succ \text{PWC (POSIX 12)} \succ \text{FREEZE (POSIX 10)} \succ \text{PASS (POSIX 0)}$
- **Pre-Ingress Join-Semilattice (L):**  
  $L = \{\bot\text{ (PASS)}, l_1\text{ (PWC)}, l_2\text{ (CORRUPT)}, l_3\text{ (REFUSAL)}, \top\text{ (BREACH)}\}$
- **Endofunctorial Yield Invariant:**  
  $\Phi : L \to E$ maps faithfully into $\operatorname{Im}(\Phi) = \{0, 12, 30, 32, 40\}$. $\text{POSIX 10 (FREEZE)}$ operates strictly outside $\operatorname{Im}(\Phi)$ as an internal runtime rate clamp ($\tau_{\text{override}} \le 11.99\text{ ms}$).
